definitions: The solid particles, especially of coffee, that remain after the liquid has been drained.
An area of land or a garden surrounding a large house or other building.
A reason or justification for a belief, action, or argument.
The basis for a legal action or claim.
Sediment at the bottom of a liquid.
examples: Coffee grounds can be used as fertiliser.
There were no grounds for his dismissal.
She sued on the grounds of discrimination.
There were grounds in the bottom of the teacup.
